items.title: Slide Hampton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He was with a guy, and this guy knew me. He introduced me to Charlie Parker.

ctx.x: I met him. I didn’t know him, but I met him.

items.title: Slide Hampton interviewed by Monk Rowe, West Orange, New Jersey, July 30, 2003
items.q: I actually made it up — it was actually a sort of a copy from the Charlie Parker break that he had made.

ctx.x: It was a unison lick, right?
Yeah. I actually made it up — it was actually a sort of a copy from the Charlie Parker break that he had made.
Yeah. That was great. I just had to tell you that, that it certainly made an impression.
